steps.content: Before opening her eyes, Crache first catches sound of the wind, and feels grains of sand caressing her face. The weather is a bit chilly.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: You're awake? Had a nice dream of soaring in the sky?

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: I know kids all love dreams like that.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Tsk, it's you.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Where am I? Where's ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I have to take him back. There are people waiting for him.
steps.female_content: I have to take her back. There are people waiting for her.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Leave tedious stuff like that to the grown-ups. In a bit, I'll send you back to your cute little Homeless friends.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Will the grown-ups be able to handle it? "You guys" are the ones who made Syndicate end up like this.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Ha. Then why don't you try to go on your own?
Crache pouts in dissatisfaction and looks around. The huge raven is flying over the city at least fifty meters high. She finally gives up on trying to leave the bird.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: What a pity it is to be stuck here with no way out. But think about it. If you had a broader outlook and greater knowledge, maybe you'd be able to find a way to escape the bird?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Must you lecture me right here and now?

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Well, I have a captive audience right now. What a great opportunity. Want me to tell you about the history of DisCity?

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: It's a story I never heard in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Look. The desert in the distance used to encompass all of DisCity. This entire city-state used to be desert, and after the Perishing Star fell, it also became the center of calamity.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: For a long time, people didn't have Hypercubes and were helpless against disasters. They fought each other for pitifully few resources, and had no hope of solving any problems.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Weren't they similar to today's Syndicate? They had even fewer choices than we do today.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: "However, even in such darkness, humanity didn't give up and eventually found hope. They used Hypercubes to withstand the indomitable Apocalypse, and established a great city-state in the middle of a barren wasteland."

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: "The very existence of this city stands as a beacon of hope in the sea of darkness."

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Oh? Where did you read that, little tyke? I've never encountered any schools in Syndicate other than the one I set up.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...In the past, when the Homeless finished their classes, they would bring back their textbooks for me to read.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: She finds herself staring into the light, tears falling quietly.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I already knew everything you said.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: But I don't see it the way you do.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: The way I see it, if Keylan hadn't come back, or if the Perishing Star had simply struck some important person's hometown, none of this would've happened.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Everything you see today is a fluke. But even with such good fortune, people still turned this place into a mess. Good things happen once in a blue moon. Misfortune and despair are constant.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I've seen too much to have any optimism. I can't change myself. I'm not a student you can teach to be good, and I don't need anyone to give me any answers.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...It's fine, you don't need to change.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This is a path you worked hard to create yourself. Even if you don't want to move forward at all and feel unhappy with each step you take, it's fine.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: As a teacher, I want to show you a bigger world. I don't need you to believe there's always light ahead. But when you do have to take a step, I hope I can help you see more routes to choose from.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: As a poet, I love the sight of you in pain, and I love how torn your soul is.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You reject hope, yet you're already the hope of many people. You hate change, yet your presence has changed the world. Only those who can't let go of the light suffer in the dark. I love that light you cling onto in your heart.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...What a load of nonsense. This is why no one reads your weird poems.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Haha. You're still around, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It's almost time for you to go. Today's class was a bit short.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: But, thanks to you, a great poem of mine will get to live on forever. Just think of it as homework and memorize it. In the future, travel wide, and tell it to others.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I want more people to see my adorable student.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I'm not asking about that. Where are you right now?
The big ink bird lets out a caw.
After a burst of gunfire, several holes get blasted into its wings. Crache's face turns blue.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Where are you, dumb bird? Where did you get all that ink?! Answer me!!
Raven doesn't answer. She just cackles and praises her own poem.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I'm your friend, they're not. So why do you care more about them than me?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Indulging in darkness, yet searching for light.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Writing poems, and becoming a poem.
The giant raven approaches the ground. She can almost see the Homeless kids waving to her. The black bird begins to dissipate, as if to say her mission is complete.
But Crache strangles the bird with her shadow, and uses it as a rein to force it to turn around. The wind whistles past her ears like bullets grazing her hair. She hears shrieks of hysteria.
Outta my way!! Where's ${PlayerName}?! Where did you take ${PlayerName} to?!
Was it that little tyke? Did ${PlayerName} leave with that kid?
Attack! Use up all that ink and those birds will come back!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Go back to the Drifter Camp! Go, hurry!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: In honor of the flames rekindled amidst the rust,

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: the winds howling amidst the forest,

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: the birds fluttering their wings in the storm, the flowers blooming in the mud... ugh, no time to come up with any more... emm...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: In honor of dreams...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: In honor of hope...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: In honor of...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...the future.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Raye!!
